CreateApiKey.description_en: Before using large models or applications in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, create an API key as an authentication credential
CreateApiKey.description_zh: 使用阿里云百炼的大模型或应用前，请先创建 API Key 作为鉴权凭证

DeleteApiKey.description_en: Deletes an authentication credential API key
DeleteApiKey.description_zh: 删除鉴权凭证 API Key

GetApiKey.description_en: Retrieves information about a specified authentication API key
GetApiKey.description_zh: 获取指定的鉴权凭证 API Key 信息

ListApiKeys.description_en: Retrieves a list of API Key authentication credentials
ListApiKeys.description_zh: 获取鉴权凭证 API Key 信息列表

UpdateApiKey.description_en: Edits the information of an authentication credential API key
UpdateApiKey.description_zh: 编辑鉴权凭证 API Key 信息
